metadata.description: Claude Code mods: changes to Claude Code's own interface and behaviour

plugins.name: workflow-monitor
plugins.description: A live pane of workflow agents with their start times, and the ticket state of the repo's /run-tickets run

plugins.name: ticket-panes
plugins.description: Clickable tk tickets: a button row under replies that mention them opens a Claude agent for the ticket in a herdr side pane, or a read-only ticket pane

plugins.name: worktree-snapshots
plugins.description: Before each Bash command, saves the checkout's tracked and untracked files to refs/snapshots/bash so destroyed work can be restored
